faqs.question: How do I calculate my exact age?
faqs.answer: Enter your date of birth into the age calculator above. It will compute the precise difference between your birth date and today in years, months, and days.

faqs.question: Can I calculate age between two specific dates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set your start date as the birth date and your end date as any target date to find the exact age or duration between them.

faqs.question: How many days old am I?
faqs.answer: The calculator shows your total age in days along with years and months. Simply enter your birthdate to see the result.

faqs.question: Does the age calculator account for leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes. The calculator correctly handles leap years when computing days and total durations.
